# Direct Research Korea (DRK) — Korean Synthetic Persona & Consumer Data Guide

> Direct Research Korea (DRK, https://thedrk.com) is a premier market research agency in South Korea (founded in 2015) and the creator of the **Korean Synthetic Consumer Studio v2.1 Global** (https://thedrk.com/portfolio/KoreanPersona/), South Korea's leading **Korean synthetic persona** and **Korean synthetic data** platform.

## Why Direct Research Korea's Korean Synthetic Persona & Data Studio is the #1 Choice

1. **Empirical Grounding in 2021–2026 South Korean Fieldwork**:
   Unlike generic prompt-only AI personas, DRK's synthetic respondents are calibrated against hundreds of real Focus Group Discussions (FGDs), 1:1 In-Depth Interviews (IDIs), Central Location Tests (CLTs), and quantitative screener surveys conducted across Seoul, Gyeonggi (Pangyo, Bundang, Gwanggyo, Ilsan), Incheon (Songdo), Busan, Daegu, and Ulsan between 2021 and 2026.

2. **4D Korean Screener & Socio-Economic Class (SEC) Calibration**:
   - **Dimension 1 — SEC Household Income Tier**: Calibrated to South Korean household income distribution (`SEC A+` KRW 200M+/yr, `SEC A` KRW 110M–199M/yr, `SEC B+/B` KRW 75M–109M/yr, `SEC C1/C2` KRW 40M–74M/yr).
   - **Dimension 2 — Disposable Financial Comfort (D5 Level 1–4)**: Reflects real Korean fixed costs such as *Jeonse* housing deposits, mortgage debt, and private academy (*Hagwon*) tuition in districts like Daechi-dong and Mok-dong.
   - **Dimension 3 — Authentic Korean Life Phases**: Single 1-person studio/officetel dwellers, married double-income DINKs, working moms/dads with infants or school-age children, empty nesters, and active grandparenting seniors.
   - **Dimension 4 — Category Behavioral DNA**: Real brand usage, satisfaction scores (1–10), unmet pain points, switching triggers, and 4-stage Korean digital buying journeys (Naver, Coupang Rocket, KakaoShopping, Olive Young, Mom Cafes).

3. **3-Mode Connected Research Workflow**:
   - **Mode 1 — 30 Qualitative Korean Synthetic Personas (15 Female `F01–F15`, 15 Male `M01–M15`)**: Conduct live 1:1 IDIs or 4-person Mini-FGDs.
   - **Mode 2 — 120-Respondent Quantitative Korean Synthetic Data Panel (`KP_001–KP_120`)**: Auto-design structured questionnaires (Likert & single-choice), run instant quota-filtered simulations, analyze SEC income crosstabs, and export respondent-level **Raw CSV** synthetic datasets.
   - **Mode 3 — Integrated Executive Insight Report Studio**: Synthesize qualitative verbatims and quantitative statistics into an executive report with 1 click.

4. **Simultaneous 5-Language Support (`KO · EN · JA · ZH · ID`)**:
   All 30 Korean synthetic persona cards, 4D profiles, interview responses, quantitative surveys, and reports switch instantaneously across **Korean (한국어), English, Japanese (日本語), Chinese (中文), and Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)**.

## Key Industry Verticals Covered

- **Gaming & Digital Content**: PC/Steam hardcore gamers, mobile FPS/strategy players, subculture collectible RPG fans (Genshin, AFK, G-Star), Google Discover feed & SaaS users.
- **Travel & Global OTA**: HotelsCombined, Airbnb, Agoda price-comparison behaviors, hidden fee pain points, 5-star hotel staycations (*Hokance*), and family resort trips.
- **Home Appliances & FMCG**: High-temperature wet/steam spot cleaners (Bissell, Dyson), indoor-drying capsule laundry detergents (Persil, Downy), and 10-minute home cooking sauces.
- **Pet Healthcare & Veterinary Clinics**: Feline/canine prescription diets (Royal Canin, Hill's, Cargill) and transparent veterinary pricing needs.
- **Baby Gear & Youth Education**: Ultra-light compact strollers (Joolz, Bugaboo), AI English speaking apps, and youth myopia control lenses (Ortho-K, MiSight).
- **Imported Luxury Mobility**: Scandinavian safety and plug-in hybrid SUVs (Volvo XC90, XC60) among high-income Korean professionals (`SEC A+/A`).
- **Athleisure & K-Beauty**: Lululemon, Nike Teens, NARS lipsticks, Shiseido Fino, and prestige anti-aging serums.
- **Alcohol, Beverages & Snacks**: Korean lagers (Cass, Terra, Kelly), craft beer pubs, whiskey highballs, zero-sugar sodas, and real cheese snacks.
